properties.name: Phase 7, PR 3: one composed check runs over a hub and several of its designs
properties.rationale: Phase 7 PR 3 (epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine, sequence 768), on Anthony's word 2026-10-21 ("Go with recommendations ... start another reflow2 epoch/increment"), from hxm_program's hub feedback of 2026-10-20, item 2: an effort in a hub of 15 local designs spans 3-6 of them, and compose_and_analyse took one other design, so the hub ran it pairwise and stitched the replies, and the seam between two members was never analysed unless one was the hub. Delivers req:one-composed-check-runs-over-a-hub-and-several-of-its-designs (not req:two-or-more-designs-are-compared-on-one-topic-on-demand, which compares topic neighbourhoods side by side). The argument is other_graph_ids, not `designs`, because `designs` sits one letter from the inline `design` export and other_graph_ids is already analyze_alternatives' word for several designs by graph_id; tracked_designs is search_design's word. tool_confusability --validate agrees 228/228 top-1. The pin resolution is PR 2's (read_document split out of tracked.rs read), not a second one. Each test is a class invariant (pin states, 1/2/N designs, node types) and failed on main a8e3be969 first, except the hosted old-shape test, a regression guard that passes on both. Measured on a release build through the door, the PR 2 fixture (15 exports + hub, 3,196 nodes, 4,731 edges): 5.8-6.8 s and 225-231 MB peak per composed check, 1,910 findings, reply 29,965 characters at the default budget (1.07 MB whole); the ordinary checks alone on one store holding the same nodes take detect_gaps 2.5-3.8 s + detect_defects 3.2-3.5 s, so the checks are the cost, not reading; the tracked search, which builds 15 searchable designs, takes 2.6-3.0 s against 0.12-0.15 s plain, bounding that building at about 2.5-2.9 s, which composing skips. Composing reflow2's own 7,882-node design alone takes 25 s and 563 MB. No schema change, so the stamp does not move. Open: dec:idea-a-composed-check-says-which-findings-only-the-composition-made (118 UnthreadedCluster findings on the fixture exist only because the members are composed without links). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: compose_and_analyse takes other_graph_ids (several designs) or tracked_designs: true (every design this one pins): one combined graph built in memory and thrown away, each design under its own graph_id, the ordinary checks run once, and each finding filed by_design, by_pair ('a×b'), across or of_the_whole, its ids in the form get_node opens. Served alone (the --call door) each design is read from its pin's committed export through tracked.rs's one pin resolution, the document only; on a registry from its live store through the one door, inside the readable set; through a hub's address tracked_designs composes every member. Each design not read is named in not_composed with the tracked search's states (unreachable on a registry). The reply is bounded by budget_chars (default 30,000), sampling only finding lists. Nothing is written. The one-other-design call answers exactly as before. The hub skill says to run it before work several designs share.
